notice: Derived extraction; authentication, transport envelopes and payload staging omitted. Original hash is in the disposition manifest. Device output is an observation, not proof of emitted light.

observations.command:
set -eu
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
cat /proc/uptime
for f in idVendor idProduct bcdDevice product serial busnum devnum bConfigurationValue; do printf '%s=' "$f"; cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/$f; done
for n in 0 1 2; do test ! -L /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.$n/driver; done
echo USB_INTERFACES_UNBOUND
bus=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/busnum)
num=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/devnum)
node=$(printf '/dev/bus/usb/%03d/%03d' "$bus" "$num")
count=0
for fd in /proc/[0-9]*/fd/*; do link=$(readlink "$fd" 2>/dev/null) || continue; if test "$link" = "$node"; then echo "USB_FD_HOLDER=$fd"; count=$((count+1)); fi; done
printf 'USB_FD_HOLDERS=%s
' "$count"
cat /proc/uptime
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo POST_LIFECYCLE_HOST_COMPLETE
